packageRules.description: The Pinniped image is digest-pinned, which the flux/helm-values manager cannot express. The pinniped-image custom manager owns it instead, so both managers do not fight over the same lines.

Keycloak publishes no official operator chart, so we track the kubitus rebuilds. Their versions are 1.0.<build timestamp> (the operator version lives in appVersion), so every release reads as a patch bump and the repo-wide patch opt-out above hides all of them. Drop this rule once we move to the official chart at oci://quay.io/keycloak/keycloak-operator-helm, which is versioned with the operator itself.
